content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves D4 vs C2 by declaring the Luke 2:48-49 witness underdetermined and internally qualified, which is a verse-level disposition governed by K-C rather than a chain-by-chain footing comparison.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D4 vs C2 (Luke 2:48-49): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"\"collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse\": I weighed (1) the judge must compare the pressed chain and the responding chain by footing and (2) the judge may instead resolve the matter by finding Luke 2:48-49 underdetermined or internally qualified.","why":"The judge marked D4/C2 underdetermined and relied on the immediate qualification of Mary's phrase in Luke 2:48-49, rather than weighing the competing chains by footing as K-C requires."}
